investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Pixlane Cloud (collaboration SaaS); Platform: Microsoft Azure eastus2 (zones eastus2-1/eastus2-2/eastus2-3); network range 10.3.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster pixlan-prod-eastus (AKS); Database: postgres instance search-db-01 for search-api; Deployments: Helm releases rolled out by a CI release bot after human approval; Change management: production changes carry CHG- identifiers.
